meta.source: Flood013 (Albert R. Costa), 'The Value of Defense including Out-of-Position Players', Fans of Diamond Mind Baseball forum (reposted by What Cheer Wombat, May 2010), https://www.tapatalk.com/groups/fansofdmb/the-value-of-defense-including-out-of-position-pla-t2569.html
meta.units: runs saved per season vs a player rated Av/100 at the played position, one team, every inning of a 162-game season
meta.setup: DMB 9c, 1952 season (error rates match neutral era), neutral parks/era (~4.8 R/G), 50 seasons per scenario, players rated at one position only
meta.keys: played -> by_rated -> range -> error_rate; diagonal (rated == played) is in-position; arm and passed balls are from separate scenarios at Av/100
